coverage.dead_rule: dead = liquidity < $5,000 (on-chain WSOL vault x2 x SOL price, then DexScreener) OR no trade/pool tx in last 7 days (DexScreener 24h txns, else pool's last signature via RPC)

sources.note: Pre-PumpSwap graduates (pump.fun migrated to Raydium AMM v4 until Mar 2025). Identified by pump-suffix base mint + WSOL quote; Raydium v4 has no on-chain migrator field, so this is a heuristic.

sources.note: Read all 1,885,709 Meteora DBC pools on-chain; 116 have a '...fomo' base mint; 2 have is_migrated=1 (graduated to DAMM v2).

sources.name: fomopad_api:/api/tokens (FomoPad verified launch registry)
sources.note: API scope '50 most recent verified launches'; returned 26 (< cap, so this is the full registry)

fomo.definition: Fomo launchpad = FomoPad (fomopad.name, independent; not an official FOMO Labs product). Coins have vanity mints ending in 'fomo' and launch on Meteora DBC (or Stonk.fun); DBC graduates migrate to Meteora DAMM v2.

launchpad_notes.pumpfun: Every canonical PumpSwap graduation pool + pump-suffix Raydium v4 pools read on-chain (complete for PumpSwap; Raydium v4 is a suffix heuristic).
launchpad_notes.fomo: FomoPad (fomopad.name, independent of FOMO Labs): all Meteora DBC pools read on-chain and filtered to '...fomo' mints, plus the FomoPad registry (DBC + Stonk.fun). Stonk.fun launches are only known via the registry; their graduation is detected by a live DEX pair. The Fomo app (fomo.family) itself is not a launchpad - its 'Graduated' list shows other launchpads' (mostly pump.fun) graduates <24h old, which the pump.fun set already covers.

caveats: This run: official RPC blocked getTokenLargestAccounts with 429.

Public Solana RPC often rate-limits getTokenLargestAccounts (HTTP 429). When that happens, holder percentages use getTokenSupply + getMultipleAccounts on RugCheck's top accounts (live balances, snapshot set) or a RugCheck snapshot.
getSignaturesForAddress does not include signers, so early-buyer clustering is only a light check.
RugCheck insider-network percentages can overlap; the scanner treats the sum as an upper bound.

All-graduated mode: universe = every canonical PumpSwap graduation pool + pump-suffix Raydium v4 pools read on-chain, plus every Fomo-launchpad ('...fomo' mint) Meteora DBC pool read on-chain and the FomoPad registry, plus pump.fun API / GeckoTerminal / DexScreener search where reachable; legacy trending feeds are added as extras.
This is research/alerting only - never a trade recommendation.
